name: double leg butt kick
description: A bouncy jump where both heels flick up toward your glutes. It gets your heart rate up and warms up the hamstrings.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed.
Kick both heels up toward your glutes while you are in the air.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with slightly bent knees.
Go straight into the next jump at a steady rhythm.
